notes: Smart Split history now supports real server-side auto-cleanup: deleted splits get a Firestore TTL expiry field (30 days out) alongside the existing on-open cleanup, so old history entries get removed even if you never open that screen again. Requires a one-time Firestore TTL policy setup on the backend (collection group splitHistory, field expiresAt) - no action needed on your phone, this is a backend/console step. No other user-facing changes in this release.
